title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack .Net + React
description:
Código da Vaga: 58095


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


Responsabilidades:

Experiência em .NET e React

Projetar, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços;

Gerenciar e otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.);

Desenvolver integrações e fluxos assíncronos utilizando RabbitMQ ou Kafka e outras soluções de mensageria;

Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB); Garantir boas práticas de segurança,

Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes);

Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.


Contratação CLT + Hibrido no Rio de janeiro 3 dias.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

Principais Responsabilidades


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter integrações entre o SAP e outros sistemas (internos e externos).
  • Trabalhar com middleware e tecnologias de integração como SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI, BTP, API Management e Web Services (SOAP/REST).
  • Implementar e monitorar processos de troca de dados via IDocs, RFCs, OData e BAPIs.
  • Garantir a segurança, escalabilidade e eficiência das integrações.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e negócio para alinhar soluções às necessidades estratégicas da empresa.
  • Identificar e solucionar problemas de integração, otimizando processos e garantindo alta disponibilidade.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica e boas práticas de integração.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência comprovada com integração de sistemas SAP.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration), API Management e Web Services.
  • Experiência com IDocs, RFCs, OData e BAPIs.
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação e formatos de dados como XML, JSON, EDIFACT e CSV.
  • Conhecimento em ABAP, Java, JavaScript ou Groovy para customizações de integração.
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a serviços (SOA) e microsserviços.

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • The client operates a global employment technology platform that connects millions of job seekers with companies through a large-scale search engine for job opportunities.
  • The organization is highly data-driven and focuses on building reliable, high-availability systems to support large volumes of traffic and data processing.
  • Their mission centers on improving access to employment through technology, analytics, and scalable infrastructure.
  • The culture emphasizes large-scale data engineering, experimentation, and operational excellence across distributed systems.


About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.


Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
  • Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
  • Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
  • 7+ years of experience with Python (7–9 years).
  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).
  • Apache Airflow (pipeline development and orchestration).
  • Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
  • Apache Kafka.
  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.


Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
  • Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • BYOD required (bring your own device).

Requisitos:

  • Experiência Bancos de Dados (SQL e NoSQL);
  • Oracle;
  • MongoDB;
  • RDS;
  • Experiência com comunicação por mensageria (RabbitMQ e SQS);
  • Experiência, compreensão e entendimento de arquitetura de micro serviços;

  • Experiência com Axway - API Gateway;
  • Experiência com Git e Versionamento de Código;
  • Experiência com Dynatrace;
  • Conhecimento de Clean Code, Clean Architecture e Modularização;
  • Boas práticas de código, documentação e desenvolvimento de telas e componentes;

  • Excelentes habilidades para resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Estar disposto a buscar novos conhecimentos e encarar novos desafios;
  • Experiencia em projetos de alta complexidade técnica e de processos.

  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (CA tools specialist)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (CA/Broadcom tols) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Experience with CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Experience with CA FAVER, CA Allocate (installation, configuration, training).
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX programs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Experience with IBM storage tools .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer with strong backend expertise and solid experience in API integrations to join our team. This role will focus on building and maintaining integrations with Shopify Fulfillment Services, designing robust event-driven systems, and ensuring high reliability across distributed components.


If you are passionate about scalable architectures, clean code, and solving complex integration challenges, this opportunity is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Build internal system adapters and perform complex data mapping
  • Implement webhook processing and event-driven workflows
  • Design robust error handling, retry strategies, and idempotent processes
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests
  • Collaborate with the team on API design, architecture decisions, and technical improvements
  • Debug and troubleshoot production issues with a proactive mindset


✅ Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience with Python development
  • Strong experience building and consuming REST APIs
  • Solid knowledge of webhook architecture and event handling
  • Experience with OAuth authentication flows
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms (Shopify experience is highly preferred)
  • Experience with asynchronous processing and message queues
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Fluent English communication skills

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)

title: Gerente de negócios
description:
Descrição da vaga


Evoluir as práticas, ferramentas e habilidades de administração de vendas e gestão de contas para aprimorar o atendimento das expectativas dos nossos clientes e expandir em novos negócios


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar as áreas de negócios na prospecção, qualificação e fechamento de oportunidades de vendas, identificando necessidades, prazos e orçamento para a venda de produtos e/ou serviços oferecidos pela empresa, e utilizando o CRM na gestão das contas nomeadas e oportunidades em cada fase do processo de venda, visando atingir as metas estabelecidas;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais para venda de produtos e serviços em soluções departamentais e/ou corporativas, negociando as condições das propostas para a efetivação da venda e analisando condições técnicas e comerciais de contratos de prestação de serviços com base na orientação da área de Contratos;
  • Estruturar proposta técnica com apoio do arquiteto, entendendo os requisitos do cliente, identificando e estruturando soluções de negócios que atendam às necessidades dos clientes e compondo preços de vendas de produtos/soluções e serviços;
  • Formular termos de referências e propostas comerciais, utilizando como referência modelos existentes e contando com apoio (Gestão, Executivo, Arquiteto, Gerente de Negócios ou Analista de Negócios);
  • Realizar apresentações executivas de produtos/soluções e serviços para clientes.
  • Criar estratégias de posicionamento dos produtos/soluções da Imagem nos clientes, mapeando perfis de cliente e identificando influenciadores, decisores, agentes externos e concorrentes;
  • Interagir com as todas as áreas promovendo o alinhamento de ideias e práticas em relação aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa;
  • Desenvolver e manter uma rede comercial consistente, contemplando carteira de clientes e rede de contatos que contribua para a geração de negócios da empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Graduação completa;
  • Conhecimento em processo de venda de produto e serviços;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Técnicas e habilidades para o desenvolvimento de vendas; Conhecimento dos principais concorrentes no mercado.


Habilidades Desejáveis:


  • Microsoft Office;
  • Power BI;
  • Conhecimentos de Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem;
  • Experiência em vendas de soluções para Governo;


Informações adicionais

Por que escolher a Geosistemas?


Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

Residência de alto padrão busca Governanta Residencial  para atuação estratégica e operacional, com foco em organização, gestão da rotina doméstica e excelência no padrão de entrega.

 Sobre a função

A governanta será responsável por garantir o perfeito funcionamento da casa no dia a dia, atuando como elo entre família, funcionárias e fornecedores. Espera-se postura profissional, visão de hotelaria aplicada à residência e capacidade de antecipar necessidades.

 Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão da rotina doméstica e acompanhamento das atividades diárias
  • Organização e manutenção do padrão da casa
  • Coordenação e supervisão de funcionárias (babás, faxineiras e demais prestadores)
  • Controle de cronogramas, enxoval, materiais e insumos
  • Interface direta com os proprietários
  • Garantia de discrição, confidencialidade e excelência no atendimento

 Perfil desejado

  • Experiência comprovada como governanta residencial
  • Postura ética, discreta e extremamente profissional
  • Organização, liderança e senso de prioridade
  • Comunicação clara e respeitosa
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com alto nível de exigência e padrão
  • Vivência em casas de alto padrão será um diferencial

 Requisitos

  • Referências profissionais comprovadas
  • Disponibilidade para dedicação integral
  • Comprometimento com padrões elevados de qualidade
  • Apresentação pessoal alinhada ao ambiente de luxo residencial

 Oferecemos

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado de alto padrão
  • Ambiente estruturado e profissional
  • Relação de trabalho clara, organizada e respeitosa

 Candidatura

Interessadas devem enviar currículo e breve apresentação profissional. Apenas candidatas dentro do perfil serão contatadas: .

title: [Vendas] Consultoria de vendas Pleno | Produto RH
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Ser referência para entender, demonstrar e validar os requisitos técnicos e comerciais de um determinado produto e/ou serviço TOTVS, a fim de apoiar os canais de distribuição na geração e desenvolvimento de novas oportunidades de negócios.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Ter bom conhecimento de um produto ou serviço TOTVS, de baixa complexidade, para realizar demonstrações e validações de requisitos técnicos;
  • Conhecer a política comercial e tabela de preço do produto ou serviço sob seu domínio para apoiar os canais de distribuição TOTVS em suas negociações;
  • Interagir com clientes e/ou prospects, com alto nível de orientação e supervisão, por meio dos canais de distribuição TOTVS, para esclarecer suas dúvidas e propor soluções relacionadas ao produto sob seu domínio;
  • Preparar ambientes e sistemas, com alto nível de orientação e supervisão, para a realização de demonstrações, eventos e webinars;
  • Demonstrar o produto ou serviço TOTVS sob seu domínio aos clientes e/ou prospects, através do cumprimento do checklist da apresentação, roteiro e processos estabelecidos pela área;
  • Apoiar, com alto nível de orientação e supervisão, na execução dos planos táticos de vendas dos canais de distribuição TOTVS;
  • Elaborar relatórios para ESNs e/ou Arquitetos dos projetos, apresentando os pontos relevantes de dúvidas e questionamentos do cliente através de ata da reunião.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

Formação: Graduação Completa


Conhecimentos:

  • Pacote Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Notes) - nível básico;
  • Pacote Google Workspace (Google Forms, Gmail, Drive, Google Sheets, etc.) - nível básico


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Bicicletário;

● Vestiário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

title: Compliance Officer
description:
Compliance Officer


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We are looking for a meticulous and proactive Compliance Officer to ensure our operations and business activities adhere to all legal, technical and regulatory requirements, as well as internal policies. As a key member of the compliance team, you will work across departments to promote a strong compliance culture and help safeguard the company’s integrity and reputation.


Responsibilities:


  • Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant regulatory authorities (MGA, Mincetur, SPA, AGCO etc.) 
  • Ensure compliance with relevant frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS).
  • Conduct regular audits and technical assessments to evaluate risk and compliance.
  • Develop and maintain compliance documentation, including security policies, data handling procedures, and audit reports.
  • Assist Chief Compliance officer to launch the new project in existing or new markets.
  • Stay up to date with changes in laws and regulations affecting data privacy,  various regulatory frameworks, cybersecurity, and industry standards.
  • Provide guidance and training to staff on compliance-related matters.
  • Manage third-party vendor compliance assessments and onboarding processes.
  • Coordinate internal and external audits; respond to audit findings and implement corrective actions.
  • Assist in incident response investigations and ensure post-incident compliance actions are executed.


Requirements:


  • 2-4 years of experience in compliance or risk/aml management (IT security would be a plus).
  • Previous experience in compliance, data protection laws and cyber security.
  • Exceptional documentation and analytical skills.


Working with us implies:

﻿

  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
Mobile Developer (React Native / Expo)

12 Month +

200-275 USD per day

Remote Euro time zone


Contract | Fully Remote


We’re looking for a Mobile Developer to help build and scale consumer-facing mobile applications. This is a hands-on product role focused on delivering high-quality, performant cross-platform experiences for iOS and Android.

You’ll work closely with backend and product teams to ship features quickly while maintaining clean architecture and a smooth user experience.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and Expo
  • Develop new features with a strong focus on performance, usability, and code quality
  • Collaborate with backend engineers and product to scope, design, and implement functionality
  • Ensure high-quality releases through testing and debugging
  • Own deployments to App Store and Google Play
  • Continuously improve app architecture and user experience


Must Have

  • 3+ years professional experience building mobile applications
  • Strong experience with React Native and Expo
  • Proven experience shipping production apps for both iOS and Android
  • Solid JavaScript / TypeScript skills
  • Focus on performance, clean architecture, and UX
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Fluent spoken English


Nice to Have

  • Experience with React.js
  • Experience working closely with Node.js backend teams
  • Startup or scale-up experience
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for mobile apps

title: Partner Strategy & Management Manager
description:
At Keeta, we are building the future of food delivery in Brazil. As part of Meituan’s global ecosystem, our mission is clear: help people eat better and live better.


We are looking for a Partner Strategy & Ecosystem Manager to architect and scale our partner ecosystem. This is a strategic role responsible for designing commercial frameworks, performance systems, and lifecycle processes that enable partners to grow while strengthening platform performance.


About the Role


In this role, you will define how Keeta structures, incentivizes, manages, and scales Sales BPO. You will balance commercial objectives with partner enablement, ensuring sustainable growth across the marketplace.

You will act as the strategic bridge between partners and internal stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


Partner Strategy & Process Framework

• Design comprehensive partner strategies, including commercial models and incentive structures

• Develop partnership economics that balance growth and profitability

• Optimize compensation and performance frameworks aligned with market dynamics


End to End Partner Lifecycle

• Build scalable onboarding, training, and enablement processes

• Define recruitment, evaluation, and transition standards

• Create structured frameworks for ongoing partner support


Performance Management & Execution

• Develop and implement partner performance evaluation systems

• Analyze performance results and drive improvement initiatives

• Translate strategic priorities into clear execution plans for partner managers


Settlement & Operational Excellence

• Execute partner settlement processes with accuracy and timeliness

• Identify opportunities to improve settlement efficiency and transparency

• Partner with Product to enhance systems and workflow automation


Requirements

• Experience in food delivery, e-commerce, marketplace, or on demand services

• Experience building scalable partner lifecycle processes

• Strong analytical skills with Excel, SQL, or BI tools

• Advanced English proficiency for cross border collaboration

• Availability to work on site in São Paulo


Why Join Keeta

• Shape the strategic foundation of Keeta’s partner ecosystem in Brazil

• High ownership and visibility from day one

• International exposure with global collaboration

• Startup speed combined with global scale support


If you are excited about building scalable partner ecosystems, designing commercial strategies, and driving marketplace growth, we would love to hear from you.

#Keeta #EatBetterLiveBetter #PartnerStrategy #Marketplace #CommercialStrategy #EcosystemGrowth

title: React Application Architect
description:
About You

You are an Application Architect specializing in marketing technology and digital analytics platforms. You enjoy designing scalable, privacy-compliant architectures that enable reliable data collection, attribution, and measurement across complex digital ecosystems. You take ownership of architectural decisions, think in systems, and balance technical rigor with business impact.

You are comfortable operating across marketing, analytics, and engineering teams, translating complex technical concepts into clear guidance, and defining standards that improve data quality, performance, and long-term maintainability.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of experience in application architecture, marketing technology, or analytics engineering roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of React , JavaScript, HTML, and CSS to implement and debug complex tracking solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency with Google Tag Manager, including custom JavaScript variables and structured data layer implementations.
  • Strong experience implementing and governing Google Analytics 4, including event modeling and advanced tracking strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with Facebook Business Manager, Facebook Pixel, and Conversions API.
  • Solid understanding of Google Ads conversion tracking and remarketing integrations.
  • Proven experience designing client-side and server-side tracking architectures.
  • Strong understanding of privacy regulations, Consent Mode, and browser restrictions (ITP) and their impact on data collection.
  • Experience using browser developer tools and tag debugging extensions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Architect and implement a modular, scalable application architecture for marketing data collection and digital analytics.
  • Own and optimize advanced Google Tag Manager configurations, including tags, triggers, variables, and structured data layers.
  • Govern tracking implementations across Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, and Facebook Pixel, including Conversions API integrations.
  • Design tracking solutions resilient to browser privacy restrictions and compliant with global privacy regulations.
  • Lead the transition from fragmented client-side tracking to robust server-side and API-driven architectures when appropriate.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex, production-level tracking and performance issues affecting data accuracy or site stability.
  • Conduct regular audits to ensure data accuracy, attribution integrity, and alignment with business and marketing objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, analytics, and engineering teams to document requirements and implement new tracking solutions.
  • Optimize tracking implementations to protect and improve Core Web Vitals and overall site performance.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation and architecture standards related to tracking, performance, and system reliability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in application architecture or marketing technology roles.
  • 5+ years of experience with React.
  • Advanced experience with Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4.
  • Strong experience with Facebook Pixel and Conversions API.
  • Solid JavaScript knowledge for tracking implementations.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

  • Great career development in a fast-growing company

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: Suporte ao cliente
description:
Descrição da Empresa O Portal das Apostas é referência em soluções eficazes e sustentáveis para a indústria de apostas e entretenimento. Nosso compromisso é proteger pessoas, jogadores e parceiros, garantindo experiências personalizadas.


Salário: R$4500 + Benefícios.

Tipo de contrato: CLT - Remoto

Jornada: 08:20h Diárias

Escala: 5x2


Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um profissional para o cargo de Suporte ao Cliente, responsável por oferecer suporte técnico e assistência a nossos clientes para garantir sua satisfação e fidelização. As responsabilidades incluem responder a dúvidas, resolver problemas técnicos e fornecer orientações claras e eficientes. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e será realizado de maneira remota.

Qualificações

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Experiência em suporte ao cliente e foco na satisfação do cliente, garantindo um atendimento excelente e personalizado.
  • Habilidades Interpessoais: Competências para construir relacionamentos positivos, com capacidade de comunicação clara e empática.
  • Suporte Técnico: Conhecimento na resolução de problemas técnicos e disponibilidade para oferecer soluções rápidas e eficazes.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de analisar e interpretar dados ou situações para tomar decisões fundamentadas.
  • Desejável experiência prévia em posições similares, conhecimento na área de apostas ou entretenimento e fluência em idiomas adicionais.

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Salesforce
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and implement scalable Salesforce solutions using Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Lightning Components.


  • Customize Salesforce objects, workflows, validation rules, and approval processes.


  • Develop Apex classes, triggers, Visualforce pages, Lightning Web Components (LWC).


  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs.


  • Perform data migration and ensure data integrity.


  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.


  • Conduct unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning.


  • Stay updated with Salesforce releases and best practices.


Required Skills:


  • Strong experience in Apex, Visualforce, LWC, SOQL, SOSL.


  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration and customization.


  • Knowledge of Salesforce security model, sharing rules, and governor limits.


  • Experience with Salesforce integrations (API, middleware tools like MuleSoft).


  • Familiarity with Salesforce deployment tools (Change Sets, ANT, SFDX).


  • Good understanding of Agile methodology.

description:
O Cloud Architect será responsável por conduzir avaliações técnicas, definir estratégias de migração, criar arquiteturas alvo e liderar a execução do plano proposto. Atuará como referência técnica para o time, garantindo alinhamento com padrões de arquitetura, governança e boas práticas da AWS.


Responsabilidades Principais:

-Realizar assessment dos ambientes atuais (discovery, análise de workloads, recomendações).

-Elaborar diagramas de arquitetura, planos de migração e cronogramas detalhados.

-Definir estratégias de migração considerando segurança, performance e custo.

-Apoiar na execução do plano de migração (delivery), garantindo aderência às recomendações.

-Utilizar ferramentas de apoio à migração (ex.: RV Tools, AWS Migration Evaluator, entre outras).

-Implementar práticas de monitoramento e otimização de performance pós-migração.

-Garantir conformidade com boas práticas da AWS e padrões corporativos.

-Interagir com stakeholders e apresentar relatórios técnicos.


Competências Técnicas:

-Experiência comprovada em projetos de migração para AWS Cloud (assessment e delivery).

-Conhecimento avançado em arquitetura de soluções AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, etc.).

-Familiaridade com ambientes on-premises (virtualização, redes, storage).

-Domínio de ferramentas de migração e discovery (ex: RV Tools, AWS Migration Evaluator, AWS Application Migration Service).

-Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento de performance (CloudWatch, Dynatrace, etc.).

-Capacidade de criar diagramas técnicos (Visio, Draw.io, Lucidchart).

-Inglês fluente.


Perfil comportamental:

-Pensamento analítico e visão estratégica.

-Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma.

-Comunicação clara e habilidade para interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos.

-Orientação para resultados e foco em qualidade.

-Flexibilidade para lidar com ambientes complexos e mudanças de escopo.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms. This role focuses on incident resolution, configuration support, and close collaboration with business users and technical teams to ensure system stability and efficient contract operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 production support for Contract Management Software platforms, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to:
  • Contract templates, clause libraries, and fallback logic
  • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract type setups
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring functional and configuration-related issues.
  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to system integrations with ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support models or Agile delivery environments.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat is hiring: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking


Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting a Structural Engineer to join a US-based partner company.


In this role, you will work remotely performing structural analysis and design for projects including awnings and similar outdoor structures. This is an ideal position for an experienced engineer looking for flexible, project-based work with the potential to grow into a full-time role.


Key Responsibilities:

* Structural Analysis: perform detailed structural calculations and analysis for outdoor structures such as awnings.

* Design & Documentation: prepare structural drawings, specifications, and technical reports that meet international standards and client requirements.

* Software Modeling: use structural analysis software (SAP2000 or equivalent) to model loads, stresses, and structural behavior.

* Technical Collaboration: coordinate with architects, fabricators, and project managers to ensure structural integrity and constructability of designs.

* Quality Assurance: review designs for compliance with applicable building codes and engineering best practices.


Requirements:

* 3-5 years of experience in structural engineering, preferably with exposure to steel, aluminum, or lightweight structures.

* Advanced/Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.

* Proficiency with structural analysis software such as SAP2000.

* Strong understanding of structural mechanics, load calculations, and material properties.

* Tech-savvy: comfortable with CAD tools, Excel for calculations, and modern productivity software. Experience using AI tools to increase efficiency is a plus.

* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and communication skills.

* Self-motivated and able to manage project timelines independently in a remote setting.


What We Offer:

* 100% remote, home-office flexibility.

* Flexible hours/project-based engagement to start, with potential to develop into a full-time position.

* Exposure to international projects and clients.

* Growth opportunities within a scaling global network.

Only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Contract: PJ

Duration: Open-ended

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies while contributing to reliable, scalable systems across multi-cloud platforms.

This is a contract position , open to remote candidates located in North or South America , and will report to a Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering .


What You’ll Do

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation , responding to incidents reliably and professionally
  • Maintain and evolve AWS cloud infrastructure , leveraging automation and infrastructure-as-code
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines , enabling agile and self-service software delivery
  • Manage and support containerized applications running on Kubernetes
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers and other DevOps team members to solve complex technical problems
  • Quickly absorb technical context while ramping up in a dynamic environment
  • Contribute to best practices that enhance system reliability, scalability, and performance


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to logging, monitoring, and observability tools such as:
  • Datadog
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • ELK Stack
  • CloudWatch
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working primarily in Pacific Time (PST)


Nice to Have

  • Experience developing automation or tooling using languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., Go, Python, Java, Elixir )
  • Experience building or supporting platform tooling for development, staging, or integration environments
  • Strong skills debugging performance or networking issues in Kubernetes-based applications
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance frameworks (SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
  • Working knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas SAP MM Pleno
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Prestar suporte Nível 2 aos utilizadores do módulo SAP MM (Materials Management), incluindo processos de compras (Procure to Pay), gestão de stocks, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), GNF (Gestão Não Financeira) para contratos de compra e serviços, e gestão de dados mestre de fornecedores e materiais (Cadastro BP).
  • Investigar e solucionar incidentes e problemas funcionais relacionados com os processos de compras, gestão de inventário, avaliação de materiais, e dados mestre.
  • Realizar análises de causa raiz para problemas nos processos de requisição de compra, cotação, pedido de compra, entrada de mercadorias (MIGO), entrada de faturas (MIRO), gestão de stocks e inventário físico.
  • Efetuar configurações e ajustes no módulo SAP MM para atender às necessidades do negócio e corrigir falhas, seguindo as melhores práticas e a governança de TI.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais para melhorias ou correções que necessitem de desenvolvimento ABAP, colaborando com a equipa de Nível 3.
  • Participar ativamente nos testes funcionais e integrados de novas configurações, desenvolvimentos e melhorias no SAP MM.
  • Orientar e apoiar Key Users e analistas de Nível 1, partilhando conhecimento e auxiliando na resolução de dúvidas sobre os processos de MM.
  • Manter a documentação dos processos, configurações e soluções atualizada na
  • ferramenta Jira e na base de conhecimento.
  • Colaborar com as equipas de projeto em iniciativas de evolução do SAP S/4HANA e sistemas satélites relacionados com o módulo MM.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs para atendimento e solução de chamados.


Requisitos:

  • Profundo conhecimento dos processos de negócio de Compras (Procure-to-Pay), Gestão de Stocks e Recebimento Físico/Fiscal.
  • Conhecimento em configuração e parametrização do SAP MM (ex: estruturas organizacionais de compras, tipos de documento de compras, determinação de preços em compras, avaliação de materiais, gestão de lotes, números de série).
  • Conhecimento em processos de MRP e gestão de necessidades de materiais.
  • Familiaridade com a gestão de dados mestre de materiais e fornecedores (Business Partner).
  • Conhecimento da integração do SAP MM com outros módulos SAP (ex: FI, CO, SD, PP, QM).
  • Conhecimento em Jira para gestão de chamados.

title: Customer Service Representative (Portuguese)
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities


  • Handle customer inquiries via live chat, email, and other channels regarding accounts, trading, payments, etc.
  • Assist customers with KYC verification, account security setup, and dispute resolution.
  • Accurately document and escalate customer issues, collaborating with technical teams for complex cases.
  • Stay updated on futures trading rules and promptly communicate platform announcements/risk alerts (training provided).
  • Adapt to shift schedules (if required) to ensure coverage during target market hours.
  • Willing to work weekends and irregular hours which will include night shifts.


Requirements


  • Have an online customer support experience, and proficiency in tools like Zendesk/LiveChat.
  • Fast learner, able to master derivatives trading terminology quickly.
  • Patient, resilient, and skilled in de-escalating high-tension situations.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian/Portuguese user communication styles; finance or customer service experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English is essential.
