title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Analista PL / Consultor SAP Basis



Responsabilidades:


1. Fornecer suporte técnico avançado, aderindo aos padrões de qualidade e requisitos regulamentares, garantindo a conformidade com as políticas da empresa nos ambientes SAP Basis e SAP HANA DB.

2. Resolver incidentes complexos escalados por analistas, realizando análises de causa raiz completas e implementando soluções eficazes para resolver problemas técnicos e de segurança.

3. Facilitar a transferência de conhecimento, atualizando e gerenciando a base de conhecimento, treinando novos membros da equipe e orientando analistas para aprimorar as capacidades da equipe.

4. Gerenciar e resolver chamados complexos dentro dos SLAs acordados, colaborando com equipes de suporte multifuncionais para manter a eficiência operacional e garantir uma postura de segurança robusta.

5. Aprimorar a experiência do cliente, alcançando altas taxas de resolução no primeiro contato, minimizando resoluções rejeitadas e reaberturas de casos, enquanto mitiga proativamente as ameaças à segurança.


Requisitos:

  • Inglês avançado. - boa comunicação, participação em chamadas, etc. (OBRIGATÓRIO)
  • Sólido conhecimento do pacote de soluções SAP e arquitetura técnica, com capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócios.
  • 4. Fortes habilidades de consultoria e gestão de stakeholders – habilidades demonstráveis de apresentação, consultoria voltada para o cliente e influência até o nível executivo (C-suite). Todos os candidatos devem ser assertivos e articulados, com capacidade de desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com clientes de alto nível.
  • 5. Compreensão da estratégia de produto da SAP, incluindo o posicionamento do S/4HANA e ferramentas de habilitação e tecnologias complementares, especialmente a integração com outros aplicativos.
  • 6. Bom conhecimento das ofertas de nuvem pública GCP, AWS e Azure e arquitetura de soluções.

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.


3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Delivery Lead
description:
Required Skills & Experience


5+ years of experience in delivery lead role

Experience delivering data and analytics products in a production environment

Working knowledge of:

• ETL processes and data pipelines

• BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau

Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between business, product, and engineering teams

Demonstrated ability to identify issues early and escalate effectively


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


Experience supporting logistics, transportation, or pricing analytics initiatives

Background working with Azure-based data ecosystems

Familiarity with database backends and data modeling concepts

Experience operating in complex, cross-functional enterprise environments


Job Description


Insight Global is looking to add a Delivery Lead to their client’s Data & Analytics organization. This person will own the end-to-end delivery of logistics and transportation initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered on time with high quality and operational reliability. They will support and enhance Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and related logistics data products, ensuring business users have accurate, timely data to drive insights into transportation performance, pricing, and KPIs, etc. They will act as a key liaison between business, product, and engineering teams and will be responsible for translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, identifying gaps in definition, and partnering with Product Managers to clarify scope before work reaches engineering. They will work closely with engineers to provide business context, facilitate effective technical discussions, and proactively identify and escalate risks related to delivery quality and timelines. This role also leads or supports incident management for data, analytics, and logistics systems by triaging issues, determining actionability, collaborating with engineering on resolution, and ensuring incidents are documented and addressed to prevent recurrence. They will support sprint planning, backlog refinement, delivery tracking, and continuous improvement across delivery processes.

They will support and enhance Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and related logistics data products, ensuring business users have accurate, timely data to drive insights into transportation performance, pricing, and KPIs, etc. They will act as a key liaison between business, product, and engineering teams and will be responsible for translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, identifying gaps in definition, and partnering with Product Managers to clarify scope before work reaches engineering. They will work closely with engineers to provide business context, facilitate effective technical discussions, and proactively identify and escalate risks related to delivery quality and timelines. This role also leads or supports incident management for data, analytics, and logistics systems by triaging issues, determining actionability, collaborating with engineering on resolution, and ensuring incidents are documented and addressed to prevent recurrence. They will support sprint planning, backlog refinement, delivery tracking, and continuous improvement across delivery processes.

title: Consultor Funcional Sênior – Salesforce Field Service
description:
Consultor Funcional Sênior – Salesforce Field Service

Data de Início: Imediata

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro/RJ (100% remoto com visitas eventuais e planejadas ao cliente)

Horário de Trabalho: 9h00 às 1800


*** Modelo remoto com eventuais viagens ao Rio de Janeiro (aproximadamente uma semana a cada 2–3 meses) ***


Área: Salesforce / Transformação Digital / Field Service Management


Visão Geral da Posição

Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) Funcional Sênior com sólida experiência em Salesforce e forte atuação em projetos de Field Service. Este profissional será responsável por implementar, evoluir e sustentar soluções voltadas à gestão de operações de campo, com foco na otimização de agendas, eficiência operacional e aumento de produtividade das equipes técnicas.


A posição exige perfil consultivo e analítico, capaz de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções funcionais estruturadas no ecossistema Salesforce, atuando em ambientes corporativos complexos e de alta criticidade operacional.


O profissional terá interação constante com áreas de negócio, tecnologia e parceiros, conduzindo análises funcionais, workshops de levantamento de requisitos e garantindo a correta implementação das funcionalidades da plataforma.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Atuar como consultor funcional sênior em iniciativas de melhoria contínua e sustentação de soluções Salesforce Field Service.

• Levantar, analisar e documentar requisitos de negócio relacionados à operação de Field Service e gestão de equipes de campo.

• Configurar e evoluir funcionalidades da plataforma, incluindo Service Territories, Work Orders, Service Appointments e Work Types.

• Definir e implementar regras de agendamento, políticas de scheduling e mecanismos de otimização de rotas e agendas.

• Atuar na integração do Salesforce Field Service com outros módulos da plataforma e sistemas corporativos.

• Conduzir workshops funcionais com áreas de negócio para entendimento de processos operacionais e identificação de oportunidades de melhoria.

• Elaborar documentação funcional, especificações e fluxos de processo relacionados às soluções implementadas.

• Apoiar testes funcionais, homologação e implantação de novas funcionalidades.

• Garantir alinhamento entre requisitos de negócio, arquitetura da solução e boas práticas da plataforma Salesforce.

• Atuar em projetos com alta volumetria operacional e ambientes com múltiplas integrações.


Competências Técnicas Requeridas

• Experiência sólida em Salesforce, com atuação em projetos de implementação e evolução da plataforma.

• Conhecimento aprofundado do Salesforce Field Service.

• Experiência com os seguintes componentes da solução: Service Territories, Work Orders, Service Appointments, Work Types, Scheduling Policies, mecanismos de Optimization e Dispatch.

• Experiência na modelagem de processos operacionais de Field Service.

• Conhecimento em integração de Salesforce com sistemas corporativos.

• Experiência em levantamento de requisitos e documentação funcional de soluções.

• Capacidade de análise de processos operacionais complexos e definição de melhorias sistêmicas.


Diferenciais

• Certificação Salesforce Administrator.

• Certificação Salesforce Field Service Consultant.

• Experiência em projetos nos setores de utilities e commodities (energia, gás, água ou telecomunicações).

• Vivência em ambientes regulados ou operações de campo com grande escala operacional.



Formação

• Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.


Experiência

• Experiência comprovada como Consultor Funcional Sênior em projetos Salesforce.

• Atuação prática em projetos envolvendo Salesforce Field Service.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante a entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Sr. Desenvolvimento Cloud
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Requisitos

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento para nuvem
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Java
  • Experiência em Angular (versões 6 a 9)
  • Experiência em API Rest
  • Experiência em Testes Unitários, Integrados, API, Front
  • Experiência em Docker
  • Conhecimento de Kubernetes
  • Experiência em Banco de dados Relacional
  • Conhecimento em Banco de dados NoSQL
  • Experiência em Metodologias Ágeis


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento de Ferramentas de Monitoração (Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, OpenTelemetry)
  • Conhecimento de modelagem para microsserviços
  • Conhecimento de DDD – Domain Driven Design


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento em Alta Plataforma / Mainframe
  • Experiência comprovada em Cobol
  • Experiência em Cobol CICS para aplicações transacionais online
  • Experiência em Natural/Adabas
  • Experiência em JCL para processamento batch
  • Experiência Com DB2
  • Experiência em Sort (DFSORT/SYNCSORT)
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e manutenção de processos batch e online
  • Conhecimento de VSAM
  • Experiência em análise e tratamento de erros em ambientes produtivos
  • Experiência com ambiente z/OS
  • Conhecimento em integração entre sistemas mainframe e plataformas distribuídas (via arquivos, mensageria ou APIs)
  • Experiência em análise de impacto, correção de incidentes e sustentação de sistemas críticos
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Capacidade de leitura, entendimento e evolução de sistemas legados complexos


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em modernização de sistemas legados (mainframe para baixa plataforma/cloud)
  • Experiência em ambientes financeiros ou bancários
  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas híbridas (mainframe + cloud)
  • Vivência em SRE, observabilidade ou monitoração de sistemas críticos
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica e apoiar desenvolvedores mais juniores


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: Desenvolvedor/a SalesForce Pleno - Remoto
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Detalhes da oportunidade

Modelo de atuação: Remoto

Modelo de contratação: CLT + Benefícios


Atuar no time de CRM Systems (Salesforce) apoiando o desenvolvimento e evolução das soluções com foco em Service Cloud, contribuindo para a qualidade técnica das entregas e integração com os sistemas corporativos da companhia.


Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento e manutenção de funcionalidades em Salesforce Service Cloud

Implementação de Apex

Desenvolvimento e manutenção de Flows

Implementação de Platform Events

Configuração e evolução de Omnichannel

Apoio na implementação de Bots

Participação nas cerimônias do squad em ambiente ágil (Scrum / Kanban)

Versionamento de código utilizando Git / GitHub

Apoio em processos de integração e deploy utilizando Jenkins

Interação com membros do time e áreas envolvidas para entendimento das demandas


Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência com desenvolvimento Salesforce

Conhecimento em Apex

Experiência com Flows

Conhecimento em Platform Events

Conhecimento em Git / GitHub

Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban)

Ingles - avançado (obrigatorio)


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Supervisor de Contas Médicas - Oncologia
description:
Requisitos:


- Superior completo.

-Excel intermediário;

-Necessário boa vivência com faturamento, auditoria de contas, conhecimento com contratos e aditivos assinados com os convênios, fechamento e análise de contas e operação de sistemas.




Atividades:


-Solicitar ao moto boy e/ou auxiliar administrativo que peguem as guias nas unidades e hospitais quando necessário;

-Receber e controlar diariamente as guias de atendimentos das unidades e hospitais;

- Mensurar o recebimento em planilha e enviar para os envolvidos no processo, sinalizando as pendências, quando for o caso;

-Distribuir a demanda das guias entre os funcionários, garantindo o equilíbrio;

-Definir a demanda do faturista curinga, observando a necessidade diária do setor;

-Cobrar as pendências não entregues, garantindo o envio dentro do cronograma do convênio e no menor tempo possível;

-Mensurar a produção diária e as guias não faturadas em planilha e enviar aos envolvidos;

- Analisar as contas fechadas pelos faturistas com o objetivo de verificar a exatidão das cobranças, orientando-os sempre que necessário;

-Sinalizar para as áreas as inconsistências encontradas nas contas com o objetivo de melhorar o desempenho de completude;

-Sugerir e/ou apoiar as áreas na solução dos problemas identificados;

-Mensurar em planilha as inconsistências encontradas nas contas e enviar mensalmente a Gerência;

-Fechar contas de consulta e procedimentos;

-Realizar o processo de auditoria de contas com os convênios que fazem pré-análise, sinalizando a Gerência sempre que houver glosas indevidas;

-Realizar contato com médicos, enfermagem, recepção, pacientes e convênios sobre os processos de faturamento e etc.




Outras informações:


- Local de trabalho: ASA SUL - Brasilia(DF);

- Escala de trabalho: 5x2 - Seg à Sex (08h às 18h) / Sex - 08h às 17h.

- Disponibilidade para treinamento.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: SAP S/4 HANA Finance Application Expert (Experto en aplicaciones financieras de SAP S/4 HANA)
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


Primary Job Purpose

Manage, support, and assist in the design and implementation of the Financial Accounting and

Controlling template including configurations and determining the best ways to use S/4 HANA by

merging business and IT needs, and focusing on utilizing the system for the greatest efficiency and

utilization.


Key Position Accountabilities

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP FICO (Financial Accounting and Controlling) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Lead and support the Finance Area in the SAP implementation project from an IT perspective and ensure timely completion of related project activities with key focus on quality.
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Analyse, create and document business processes during the project implementation.
  • Support larger project team during configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and up-grade phases.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in FICO in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects.
  • Should have a strong integration knowledge between FI-SD, FI-MM, FI-PP
  • Should have a strong knowledge Bank master setup, electronic bank statement (EBS) configuration, and cash management.
  • Proven experience in design, concept, principles, and configuration in SAP FICO area.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously (implementations, enhancements of ERP templates etc.)


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in FICO in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects with a minimum experience of 5 years.
  • Proven experience in design, concept, principles, and configuration in SAP FICO area.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously (implementations, enhancements of ERP templates etc.)
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline.

Desirable:

  • SAP Certification in SAP Financial Accounting/Controlling.

WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. title: Lead Software Engineer - AI
description:
Lead Software Engineer - AI



Job-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Develop production-ready software solutions that solve real business problems, considering business needs and technology/operations landscape; lead interaction with internal stakeholders and technology on specific projects and initiatives
  • Apply software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI techniques to derive business value from the full range of internal and external data, leveraging Cloud-based technology
  • Design solutions, build initial code, and provide documentation with ways of working to minimize time to value and maximize re-usability
  • Translate complex data and methodology into strategic, operationally feasible insights and recommendations; automate implementation
  • Communicate clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, verbally and visually, to create understanding, engagement, and buy-in
  • Identify trends and opportunities to drive innovation, both in what we do and how we do it; evaluate new software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI technologies and tools that can boost team performance, innovation, and business value
  • Manage, coach, and mentor a team of software engineers and data scientists, serving as a predominant technical expert
  • Actively contribute to and re-use community best practices
  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
  • This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of seven years’ post-secondary education or relevant work experience

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

Required skills

  • Bachelor’s/Advanced Degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or 7+ years equivalent work experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in developing a variety of software products in a commercial environment
  • 2+ years of experience in building generative AI-based products.
  • Strong Python and Typescript/JavaScript skills required;
  • Expertise in multivariate statistical modelling (e.g., clustering, regression, principal components and factor analysis, time-series forecasting, Bayesian methods) and modern machine learning (ensemble methods, regularization, gradient boosting, representation learning, deep neural networks, transformers architectures, self-supervised learning, and MLOps fundamentals) required
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or other), or equivalent on-premise platform
  • Experience working in agile methodology is required
  • Prior experience in leading data science and machine learning based software development projects focused on solving business problems and seizing business opportunities

Desired skills

  • Proficiency in SQL desirable
  • Ability to mentor and lead others; provide hands-on technical guidance; conduct code reviews
  • Ability to simultaneously coordinate and track multiple deliverables, tasks, and dependencies across multiple stakeholders / business areas
  • Experience with deep learning and neural network architectures (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, transformers), including generative and self-supervised models, and with frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is desirable.

Proficiency with data visualization tools is desirable

title: Camunda 8 Developer
description:
Corus Consulting is a consulting firm with more than 15 years of experience with different clients worldwide; we have presence in Europe, United States, Asia and Mexico.

We are looking for your talent to work as:


Camunda 8 Developer


About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Camunda Developer with knowledge in the 8th version, to join our team supporting a customer in the banking sector.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop new components, maintain and evolve existent ones according to the team priorities and product roadmap.
  • Active role on team software quality assurance, best practices and agile methodology.
  • Take responsibility of the software delivery by ensuring quality and scope expectations are met.
  • Work closely with partner technology teams and collaborate effectively.


Requirements:

  • Hand-on experience designing and implementing Camunda 8 BPMN processes.
  • Deep understanding of Java (11 or above) and Java Spring (4 or superior) and solid understanding of OO principles.
  • Solid experience Spring Boot.
  • Diligent with automated testing i.e. JUnit/Mockito/Cucumber, etc.
  • Understanding of RESTful API principles.
  • Proficiency in English (minimum B2).


Location:

  • Remote from Brazil.


Ready to bring your expertise to the next level? Apply now and join a team that's shaping the future of financial services.


Support the team and the Camunda Chapter!

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Debug, optimize, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and data workflows.
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices.
  • Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability.
  • Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.


Qualifications

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Interest in applied AI and automation-driven development.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

We only accept CVs that are in English.

title: Data Scientist - Remote - Talent Pool
description:
We’re building a talent pool for Senior Data Scientist Engineers . This pipeline role is for engineers with strong SQL and Python experience . This position plays a key role in supporting product decision-making through data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence.


What You’ll Do

  • Help clear existing backlog and enhance the team’s data infrastructure and analytics capabilities.
  • Work with ETL processes, analytics, and BI tools to drive actionable insights.
  • Create and maintain data pipelines and workflows using Airflow.
  • Perform data cleaning, transformation, and combination of existing data tables in Snowflake.
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to deliver accurate reporting and analytics.
  • Contribute to Streamlit dashboards and analytical tools.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience with Python and SQL in a data-focused environment.
  • Familiarity with data tools such as Airflow, Snowflake, and Streamlit.
  • Strong understanding of analytics best practices and product data workflows.
  • Basic knowledge or interest in cryptocurrencies, blockchain technology, and ERC-20 tokens.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to work effectively across time zones with overlap to US hours (preferably Eastern Time).


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in fintech, payments, or digital assets.
  • Understanding of blockchain data structures or related crypto analytics.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.


FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.


We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.


What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil


How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil


How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Technical Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Analyst with minimum 7 years of experience with Solaris/AIX/Linux, WebSphere, WebLogic or JBoss and various middleware infrastructure technologies.


Responsibilities:


· Evaluate, design, document, install, test, implement, monitors and maintain complex UNIX/Linux based applications such as GPP, GCP, Total Payments, and infrastructure solutions

· Configuring and support of production, testing and development environments (Solaris/AIX/Linux)

· Troubleshooting, Preparing, updating, and maintaining technical documentation and RFPs

o J2EE Application Servers – WebSphere / WebLogic / JBoss (including performance benchmark analysis)

o Microsoft Azure or Amazon EC2

o Hazelcast

o Oracle DB (including performance benchmark analysis)

o IBM MQ

o Elastic Search

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

title: Coordenador Operacional  - Elétrica
description:
Líder mundial em Recursos Humanos, a Adecco está presente em 60 países, por meio de uma rede de 5.500 delegações que diariamente proporcionam emprego a 700.000 pessoas e prestam serviços a mais de 100.000 empresas. Faz parte da Fortune Global 500 e está cotada na bolsa de Zurique. A Adecco possui uma estrutura global orientada para a oferta de soluções integradas em Recursos Humanos, com o compromisso de desenvolver continuamente serviços eficazes e competitivos para seus clientes.

Assessoramos importante empresa no segmento de Engenharia e Serviços Operacionais de Energia.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Responsável pela gestão operacional dos processos de manutenção em linha morta e linha viva, poda de árvores, serviços de rede (corte, religação e ligações novas) e plantão para atendimentos emergenciais;
  • Planejar, gerenciar e monitorar a demanda técnica fornecida pela Contratante visando garantir a produtividade, qualidade e segurança dos serviços prestados;
  • Apresentar periodicamente ao Gerente de Contrato e/ou Diretoria, relatórios financeiros e operacionais, por meio de gráficos e planilhas, propondo medidas de melhoria de acordo com os resultados obtidos;
  • Gestão dos indicadores operacionais da Contratante (DEC, FEC, Torre de Investimento, Plano de Manutenção etc.);
  • Gestão dos indicadores financeiros de produção e medição de serviços e de custo do contrato.


Requisitos:


  • Ensino superior Completo em Engenharia Elétrica;
  • CNH B;
  • Conhecimento em manutenção de redes de distribuição de energia elétrica, incluindo atividades em linha viva e linha morta;
  • Experiência em gestão operacional de equipes de campo, especialmente em serviços de rede elétrica (corte, religação, ligações novas e poda de árvores);
  • Gestão e análise de indicadores;
  • Excel Intermediário;
  • Experiência no setor elétrico na distribuição de energia em concessionárias ou empresas prestadoras de serviços;
  • Disponibilidade para residir no Norte e Nordeste;



Benefícios:

- Assistência Médica

- Assistência Odontológica

- Vale alimentação

- Auxilio Moradia

- Vale transporte

title: Product Owner
description:
Sobre a vaga


Código da vaga: 58541 e 58598


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Principais responsabilidades


  • Atuar como Product Owner, sendo responsável pela gestão e priorização do backlog do produto.
  • Escrever e refinar estórias de usuário claras, objetivas e bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite bem definidos.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre stakeholders de negócio e time de desenvolvimento.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Planning, Review, Retrospective e Daily)
  • Remover impedimentos e apoiar o time na melhoria contínua.
  • Monitorar métricas de desempenho e evolução do produto.
  • Atuar em ambiente estruturado sob o framework SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework).


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência sólida em gestão ágil de projetos.
  • Vivência prática como Product Owner.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação).
  • Excelente comunicação escrita, especialmente para elaboração de: estórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e documentação funcional.


Diferenciais


  • Conhecimento e atuação em ambientes com SAFe.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSPO, PSM, SAFe Agilist, entre outras).
  • Experiência com produtos digitais ou tecnologia.


Modelo de atuação


  • 100% remoto.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: 11161 - Desenvolvedor Salesforce
description:
Estamos em busca de Desenvolvedores Salesforce (Sêniores e Especialistas), altamente qualificados para atuarem em projetos estratégicos e de alta complexidade, com foco na implementação, customização e manutenção de soluções na plataforma Salesforce! ✨


Requisitos:

Graduação completa;

Possuir domínio avançado em Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce e SOQL;

Experiência prática com Salesforce DX, Git, CI/CD e gerenciamento de pacotes é essencial;

Deve ter conhecimento sólido no uso de ferramentas declarativas como Flow, Process Builder, Validation Rules e Permission Sets;

É fundamental ter experiência comprovada em integração de sistemas via APIs REST e SOAP, com autenticação OAuth 2.0 e uso de Named Credentials;

Conhecimento de arquitetura multiorganização (multi-org), gerenciamento de ambientes sandbox e estratégia de versionamento de código são importantes;

Desejável experiência com frameworks de testes automatizados e uso de ferramentas como Jest para LWC;

É esperado domínio dos módulos Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, além de conhecimento prático em gerenciamento de dados com Data Loader ou Workbench.


Certificações Salesforce são desejáveis, mas não obrigatórias, o foco está na experiência técnica comprovada em projetos complexos e de grande escala!

Outros diferenciais: Experiência com Financial Cloud, B2B commerce, CRM, Agentforce.


Responsabilidades :

Este profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções robustas utilizando Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC) e outras tecnologias da plataforma, garantindo alta performance, escalabilidade e aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. A posição exige grande autonomia técnica, capacidade de análise crítica de requisitos e experiência com o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento dentro do ecossistema Salesforce, incluindo integração com sistemas externos e deploy controlado via Salesforce DX;

Liderará o desenvolvimento técnico de soluções na plataforma Salesforce, desde a análise de requisitos até a entrega em produção;

Deverá implementar funcionalidades customizadas utilizando Apex, LWC, Visualforce e configurações declarativas quando apropriado. Também será responsável por modelar objetos e relacionamentos no Salesforce Data Model, configurar workflows, Process Builder, Flow e validações de dados;

Espera-se que atue na integração da plataforma com APIs REST e SOAP externas, utilizando Named Credentials e Auth Providers quando necessário. Também será responsável por garantir a qualidade do código através de testes unitários com alta cobertura, revisão de código e aplicação de design patterns aderentes ao Salesforce;

Participará ativamente de cerimônias ágeis, colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares e orientando desenvolvedores menos experientes.


Modalidade de trabalho: 100% Home-Office, podendo residir em qualquer região do Brasil!!!

Contratação: CLT Flex

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer

Brazil- Remote

Long Term Contract



Job Description:


  • Proven experience in designing and implementing data solutions on the Databricks platform.
  • Solid understanding of Databricks fundamentals/architecture and have hands on experience in setting up Databricks cluster, working in Databricks modules (Data Engineering, ML and SQL warehouse).
  • Create and maintain documentation for data pipelines, processes, and best practices.
  • Knowledge of Performance Optimization, Monitoring and Automation would be a plus.
  • Understanding of data governance, compliance, and security best practices.
  • Knowledge in anyone of the cloud platforms AWS is a must.
  • Strong Proficiency in Pyspark, Databricks Notebooks, SQL, Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Certifications in Databricks would be beneficial.
  • Strong understanding of data engineering best practices, data modeling, Data warehousing and ETL processes.
  • Staying up-to-date with the latest Databricks features and best practices.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are currently looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join a high-performing engineering team supporting multiple global consulting engagements. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building scalable data systems, working closely with stakeholders, and delivering production-ready solutions.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design and implement modern data architectures while supporting analytics and business decision-making.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and distributed data systems.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows across multiple systems.
  • Deliver production-ready data solutions , from prototype to enterprise-grade systems.
  • Partner with consulting and business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Lead analytics modules and clearly communicate technical outcomes.
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and performance of data infrastructure.


Requirements

  • Intermediate to upper-intermediate English level (B2 minimum).
  • 6+ years professional experience as a Data Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python and SQL.
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or similar).
  • Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis, Neo4j or similar).
  • Experience working with distributed data processing (Spark, PySpark, Hadoop).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).


Nice to Have

  • Workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Data Factory, or Glue.
  • Snowflake or dimensional modeling (Star Schema).
  • Streaming technologies such as Kafka.
  • Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Azure Data Lake Storage.
  • Data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.


Benefits

  • Career development plan and continuous learning.
  • Excellent work environment and flexibility as a CONTRACTOR.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Direct hiring with us.
  • English Class.
  • Benefits platform.
  • Continuous training communities/Certs.
  • AC points (bonus).
  • National Holidays.
  • Company Events (Colombia)
  • Salary: We don't have fixed salary ranges; we tailor the economic offer based on the candidate's salary expectations. In this case, you will let us know your monthly service fee as a CONTRACTOR, and that value will be taken into account when making the offer.


If you’re looking for a place where professional growth goes hand in hand with quality of life, this opportunity is for you!

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Vaga Desenvolvedor API/Backend


Estamos buscando uma pessoa desenvolvedora backend com experiência em Python / FastAPI para atuar no desenvolvimento de novas features e integrações de um SaaS de Inteligência Artificial.

Nosso produto é uma plataforma de Agentic AI, construída sobre Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e voltada para empresas que desejam escalar conversas automatizadas e integrar canais, pagamentos e agenda em um só lugar.


Sobre a Bren


A Bren é uma startup inovadora que transforma conversas em vendas, se comunicando com os clientes através do WhatsApp, 24 horas por dia. Acreditamos que equipes de vendas são essenciais para o crescimento de uma empresa, e por isso criamos soluções de automação e comunicação que aumentam a produtividade e tornam os processos mais eficientes. Nossa plataforma oferece funcionalidades como agendamento de reuniões, campanhas inteligentes, follow-up automatizado e muito mais, sempre com a voz da marca e com a inteligência da IA.


Responsabilidades


  • Evoluir o backend da plataforma (FastAPI + Google Cloud)
  • Integrar sistemas de terceiros no app (ex: fornecedores e gateways de pagamento, calendário Google e Outlook)
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o resto do time técnico (backend, frontend, e arquitetura)


Stack


  • Linguagem:  Python
  • Framework:  FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura:  Google Cloud Platform
  • Principal API externa:  WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta)


Perfil Ideal


  • Experiência comprovada com APIs e integrações externas
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas escaláveis e microserviços
  • Experiência com Google Cloud (ou AWS/Azure equivalente)
  • Conhecimento em autenticação ( OAuth2, JWT, SSO) e queries de SQL
  • Experiência com API da Meta e Whatsapp Flow é um diferencial


Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto

title: Desenvolvedor
description:
Estamos buscando um talento para a posição de DESENVOLVEDOR DE SOFTWARE SENIOR


A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 16 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 10.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em curso de nível superior na área de Tecnologia da Informação.
  • Experiência profissional na especialidade técnica de atuação.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA na área de atuação e/ou em processos de Engenharia de Software.


Atividades:

  • Codificação, design de componentes, testes unitários, construção de aplicações, implementação e manutenção de software em busca de alta qualidade na aplicação de técnicas, normas e procedimentos atualizados de codificação e construção de software.
  • Desenvolver recursos e capacidades para usuários finais através de plataformas e ferramentas de desenvolvimento ou aprendizado de máquina, escrevendo código de qualidade com clareza e testabilidade de acordo com padrões e práticas de arquitetura, design implementação e segurança.
  • Configurar e personaliza software.
  • Investigar e propor soluções para problemas de desenvolvimento e design.
  • Conduzir análises para determinar necessidades de integração, projetar e planejar integrações.
  • Desenvolver blocos de construção de software reutilizáveis para permitir uma entrega mais rápida.
  • Participar do trabalho de estimativa e previsão de trabalho.
  • Melhorar o desempenho do software existente, diagnosticando e resolvendo problemas críticos.
  • Preparar documentação técnica.
  • Colaborar no desenvolvimento de modelos de aprendizado de máquina e pipelines de dados.
  • Apoiar gerencialmente a execução e fiscalização de contratos de TIC na sua área de especialidade.
  • Apoia equipes multidisciplinares com mindset ágil;

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

description:

Location: Remote

Short-Duration Project

Industry: E-commerce

Team: International and Multidisciplinary
